name: OfficeQA Pro
titleZh: OfficeQA Pro：面向端到端有据推理的企业级基准
summary: 133 questions over U.S. Treasury Bulletins spanning nearly a century, requiring parsing, retrieval and analytical reasoning across text and tables.
summaryZh: 133 道题，取材于跨越近一个世纪的美国财政部公报，要求在文本与表格之间完成解析、检索与分析推理。
keyFact: OfficeQA Pro (Opsahl-Ong et al., arXiv:2603.08655, 2026-03-09) builds on a corpus of 89,000 pages and more than 26 million numerical values; the paper reports frontier models below 5% accuracy from parametric knowledge alone and below 12% with web access.
keyFactZh: OfficeQA Pro（Opsahl-Ong 等，arXiv:2603.08655，2026-03-09）基于 89,000 页、逾 2,600 万个数值的语料；论文报告前沿模型仅靠参数知识正确率不足 5%，即便联网也不足 12%。
whyItMatters: It isolates the gap between being able to read documents and being able to answer from them on long-tail enterprise data.
whyItMattersZh: 它把「能读文档」与「能根据文档作答」之间的差距，在长尾企业数据上单独隔离了出来。
title: OfficeQA Pro: An Enterprise Benchmark for End-to-End Grounded Reasoning
